evidence: (1) VisualTargetingComponent class record @0x27E3F58, size field (rec+0x20)=0x000000A0, class id (rec+0x1C)=0x5153C455=crc32 of name; so +0x660 sits 0x5C0 past the end of that class. (2) Image-wide byte scan for every bitfield form on [reg+660h]: 81 ?/83 ? imm, 09/0B/21/31 reg, 85 ?, F7 ? = ZERO hits. No setter, no getter, no reader of bit 0/4/6. (3) Where +0x660 is real data it is movss float (load 0xd80b72, 0x12c0600; store 0xd64617, 0xd68fc7, 0x13c9764, 0x193c1f0) or one dword of a contiguous struct the engine only assigns wholesale: sub_18A6ED0 resets 0x64C..0x698 (@0x18a7bb3); sub_184AF60/sub_184B010 copy 0x660..0x678 from [obj+0x67C] (@0x184afd9, 0x184b0bf); sub_13B8D50 deserialises 0x654..0x668 (@0x13ba322). Only mov/lea/movss forms exist. The lone 8B hit @0x19bd970 is not a data read: mov eax,[vtbl+660h]; call eax = virtual slot 102. (4) The write is in bounds, not a fault: a method of the 0x026FA898 class touches +0x938 (@0x1863fd8) so its instance is >=0x93C bytes. phase1.cpp:1932 therefore corrupts 4 bytes of an unreferenced/copied dword - it cannot set IsTargetable/IsFightable/IsMeleeTargetable. (5) FocusFlags IS a bitfield but not at +0x660: string @0x1e60d34 has 0 xrefs (hashed reflection pool); id crc32(FocusFlags)=0x9290EFFC appears only in prototype default blobs (@0x295f89c, 0x295fc9c, 0x29d57b4, 0x2a69dec, 0x2a7791c, 0x2a7995c, 0x2ab0d3c) with values 0x1E0 / 0x80. Offset unproven.
